title: PrismStudio 1.1.0 — Claude is a guest now
notes: Claude is summoned, not resident: nothing on screen and no session until you press Ctrl+Shift+C.
Choose where it opens — a tab in the bottom panel, a pane beside the editor, or its own window. Moving it keeps the session running.
Ctrl+P goes to any file in the folder, fuzzy matched. Type > in the same box for commands, : for a line number.
The menu bar is gone: one button in the title bar holds the menus, and the editor keeps the width.
Typing no longer slows down as a file grows — about thirty times less work per keystroke in a large file.
